scenes.title: A Rainy-Day Friend
scenes.body: A little fox peeked out from behind a bush. A tiny bluebird sat on a low branch, looking wet and shivery. The fox smiled softly and stepped closer.
scenes.altText: Scene 1 of a story about kindness.

scenes.title: Sharing the Warmth
scenes.body: The fox found a big smooth leaf. He held it over the bird like a little umbrella. The bird hopped closer and chirped a happy thank-you.
scenes.altText: Scene 2 of a story about kindness.

scenes.title: A Nest That Needs Fixing
scenes.body: The sun came out, and the bird hopped to a nearby tree. Its nest had blown down. The little fox knew just what to do.
scenes.altText: Scene 3 of a story about kindness.

scenes.title: Building Together
scenes.body: The fox gathered soft twigs and moss. The bird added tiny feathers. Together they made a cozy, new nest on the branch.
scenes.altText: Scene 4 of a story about kindness.

scenes.title: A Song for Kindness
scenes.body: The little bluebird settled into the new nest and sang a sweet, happy song. The fox watched with a warm heart. Kindness had made a friend for life.
scenes.altText: Scene 5 of a story about kindness.
